newsitem.title: USA: Scios suspends development of drug, stock plunges.
newsitem.headline: Scios suspends development of drug, stock plunges.

text.p: Scios Inc. said Thursday it has suspended development of a drug designed to reduce the need for dailysis in patients with kidney failure, sparking a sharp sell-off of the company's stock.
The stock slid $2.31 or more than 34 percent to $4.375 on Nasdaq, where almost 1.9 million shares changed hands in early afternoon trading.
Scios said the test drug Auriculin failed to increase the filtering capacity of the kidneys in a Phase III study.
The company said the drug was developed with Genentech, Inc., and the two companies will be discussing the future of their collaboration over the next several months.
Mountain View, Calif.-based Scios is a biopharmaceutical company engaged in the discovery, development, manufacture and commercialization of novel human therapeutics.
